frames.reason: Restrained blue lake and green land have some richness, but ground is broad flat fill and the small faceted trees have little organic mass.
Strong orange crowns and vivid orange roofs overwhelm the pale yellow ground; hard facets and flat surfaces lack matte depth.
Muted urban blocks have restrained colour but weak atmospheric and material depth, with sparse angular crowns and uniform ground.
Fine branching and irregular open foliage improve natural structure, but crowns are thin and noisy, ground stays flat, and bright orange roofs dominate.
Green ground is calmer than the warm crowns, but angular trees and hard shadows remain diagrammatic and the orange roofs compete.
Muted orange and olive crowns have some volume, but rounded lobes read as balloons beside faceted trees; shadows and surfaces are very hard and flat.
Yellow-green land is expansive and flat against the blue lake; tiny bright crowns and sparkling water do not supply the target's soft matte depth.
Brick and roof colours are restrained and legible, but ground and walls are uniform and crowns remain angular sparse objects.
More subdued autumn crowns balance the green ground, but materials remain flat, shadows rigid, and saturated roofs distracting.
Muted green terrain and blue water give a restrained balance, but broad uniform land and glittering water lack the target's surface depth.
Warm crowns bring colour to muted brick blocks, but angular foliage and unmodulated ground and buildings remain schematic.
Bright orange lobes and hard polygon crowns read as manufactured forms; vivid roofs compete and abrupt cool shadows lack softness.
Yellow ground pushes the already bright foliage and roofs toward a loud palette; balloon and faceted crowns and rigid shadows remain far from natural mass.
